resources.string: Turn websites into focused Lite Apps, with clear privacy boundaries and the tools you need to get started.
Open, search, and organize Lite Apps from the ShellAlpha home screen.
New installs start with a PostSoma Lite App. You can add other websites whenever you need them.
Lite Apps assigned to a sandbox can use separate WebView data. Site permissions and third-party network requests still depend on each website and the choices you make.
The interface follows your system language.
ShellAlpha stores app data on this device. Opening a website can send requests to that site and the services it loads.
ShellAlpha is based on NativeAlpha by cylonid. The software is licensed under GNU GPL v3.
